state.subject: Extra capture on order 7781
state.body: Order 7781 was delivered this morning, tracking and all. I am writing only because the card was captured twice for $128. Please reverse one capture. I do not need a new shipment.

queue.instructions: Which queue should own this ticket? Choose the team that can resolve what the customer is actually asking for. A mention of another team's words is not enough.

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, taxes, and payment methods
criteria.shipping: Package location, delivery address, carriers, and items lost or damaged in transit
criteria.access: Login, password, two-factor, locked accounts, and sessions
criteria.product: The app or website: bugs, outages, and how a feature works

escalate.instructions: Does a supervisor need to take this now? Yes means a legal threat, an account compromise, a repeated failure after an earlier attempt, or a site-wide outage. A ticket can be urgent and still stay with the queue.

criteria.false: The owning queue can handle it
criteria.true: A supervisor should take it now

priority.instructions: How soon does this customer need a response? Can wait means no deadline. This week means a normal service request. Today means they are blocked today. Right now means an incident in progress.
